# netbox_racks (Data Source)

Lists rack objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_racks" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-rack" },
  ]
}
```

Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.
- `name_regex` (String) Go regular expression the name must match. Applied after the API query, which then fetches every object matching the filters; limit applies to the matches.

### Read-Only

- `racks` (Attributes List) The matching racks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--racks))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--racks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `racks`

Read-Only:

- `airflow` (String) Airflow direction. One of: front-to-rear, rear-to-front.
- `asset_tag` (String) Unique asset tag.
- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `desc_units` (Boolean) Units are numbered top-to-bottom.
- `description` (String)
- `device_count` (Number) Number of devices in the rack.
- `facility_id` (String) Locally-assigned facility identifier.
- `form_factor` (String) Rack form factor. One of: 2-post-frame, 4-post-frame, 4-post-cabinet, wall-frame, wall-frame-vertical, wall-cabinet, wall-cabinet-vertical.
- `group_id` (Number) Id of the rack group.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `location_id` (Number) Id of the location within the site.
- `max_weight` (Number) Maximum load capacity (requires weight_unit).
- `mounting_depth` (Number) Maximum depth of a mounted device in millimeters.
- `name` (String)
- `outer_depth` (Number) Outer depth (requires outer_unit).
- `outer_height` (Number) Outer height (requires outer_unit).
- `outer_unit` (String) Unit of the outer dimensions. One of: mm, in.
- `outer_width` (Number) Outer width (requires outer_unit).
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `power_feed_count` (Number) Number of power feeds in the rack.
- `rack_type_id` (Number) Id of the rack type. NetBox copies the type's form factor, width, height and outer dimensions onto the rack; set the same values here too, or the next plan shows them as drift.
- `role_id` (Number) Id of the rack role.
- `serial` (String) Serial number.
- `site_id` (Number) Id of the site the rack belongs to.
- `starting_unit` (Number) Lowest unit number.
- `status` (String) Operational status. One of: reserved, available, planned, active, deprecated.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `tenant_id` (Number) Id of the tenant.
- `u_height` (Number) Height in rack units.
- `url` (String)
- `weight` (Number) Weight of the rack (requires weight_unit).
- `weight_unit` (String) Unit of weight and max_weight. One of: kg, g, lb, oz.
- `width` (Number) Rail-to-rail width in inches. One of: 10, 19, 21, 23.
